title: Lentil bolognese with wholewheat spaghetti
summary: All the comfort of bolognese, plant-based.
steps: Chop the onion, grate the carrot and crush a clove of garlic. Drain and rinse the lentils if they are tinned.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and soften the onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and a pinch of dried herbs, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Add a splash of water if it gets dry, and season with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water as the pack says (usually 10 to 12 minutes) and drain it.
Serve the sauce on the spaghetti.
